content.text: On mobile Safari the Billing Questions form accepts a screenshot attachment in the UI but submits the ticket without the file.
Desktop browsers upload the same image successfully, pointing to a multipart boundary or file input reset issue on iOS Safari.
Fix the client upload path for mobile Safari and add a device-level check that blocks submit when the attachment preview is present but the file blob is missing.
